{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm to ensure accurate mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
grouped_means = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().reset_index()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
grouped_means_sorted = grouped_means.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Display the result
grouped_means_sorted"}
